title: Dima and Hares
statementMd:
Dima liked the present he got from Inna very much. He liked the present he got from Seryozha even more.

Dima felt so grateful to Inna about the present that he decided to buy her $*n*$ hares. Inna was very happy. She lined up the hares in a row, numbered them from 1 to $*n*$ from left to right and started feeding them with carrots. Inna was determined to feed each hare exactly once. But in what order should she feed them?

Inna noticed that each hare radiates joy when she feeds it. And the joy of the specific hare depends on whether Inna fed its adjacent hares before feeding it. Inna knows how much joy a hare radiates if it eats when either both of his adjacent hares are hungry, or one of the adjacent hares is full (that is, has been fed), or both of the adjacent hares are full. Please note that hares number 1 and $*n*$ don't have a left and a right-adjacent hare correspondingly, so they can never have two full adjacent hares.

Help Inna maximize the total joy the hares radiate. :)

## Input

The first line of the input contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3000)$ — the number of hares. Then three lines follow, each line has $*n*$ integers. The first line contains integers $*a*_{1}$ $*a*_{2}$ $...$ $*a*_{*n*}$. The second line contains $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$. The third line contains $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$. The following limits are fulfilled: $0 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$.

Number $*a*_{*i*}$ in the first line shows the joy that hare number $*i*$ gets if his adjacent hares are both hungry. Number $*b*_{*i*}$ in the second line shows the joy that hare number $*i*$ radiates if he has exactly one full adjacent hare. Number $*с*_{*i*}$ in the third line shows the joy that hare number $*i*$ radiates if both his adjacent hares are full.

## Output

In a single line, print the maximum possible total joy of the hares Inna can get by feeding them.
statementZhMd:
迪马非常喜欢英娜送给他的礼物。他更喜欢谢廖沙送给他的礼物。

迪马对英娜送给他的礼物非常感激，因此决定送给她 $*n*$ 只兔子。英娜非常高兴。她把兔子排成一排，从左到右依次编号为 1 到 $*n*$，然后开始用胡萝卜喂它们。英娜决定每只兔子恰好喂一次。但她应该按照什么顺序喂它们呢？

英娜注意到，每只兔子在被喂食时都会产生快乐，而具体产生多少快乐取决于英娜是否在喂它之前喂过它相邻的兔子。英娜知道，当一只兔子进食时，它的两只相邻兔子都还饿着、恰好有一只相邻兔子已经吃饱（即已经被喂过），或两只相邻兔子都已经吃饱时，这只兔子会产生多少快乐。请注意，编号为 1 和 $*n*$ 的兔子分别没有左侧和右侧相邻的兔子，因此它们不可能拥有两只已经吃饱的相邻兔子。

请帮助英娜最大化兔子产生的快乐总和。:)

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3000)$，表示兔子的数量。接下来有三行，每行包含 $*n*$ 个整数。第一行包含整数 $*a*_{1}$ $*a*_{2}$ ... $*a*_{*n*}$。第二行包含 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$。第三行包含 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$。满足以下限制：$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$。

第一行中的数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示当编号为 $*i*$ 的兔子的两只相邻兔子都还饿着时，它获得的快乐值。第二行中的数 $*b*_{*i*}$ 表示当编号为 $*i*$ 的兔子恰好有一只已经吃饱的相邻兔子时，它产生的快乐值。第三行中的数 $*с*_{*i*}$ 表示当编号为 $*i*$ 的兔子的两只相邻兔子都已经吃饱时，它产生的快乐值。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出英娜喂兔子时能够获得的快乐总和的最大值。
